simple.meaning: a receptacle (for milk, i.e. pail; figuratively, breast)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עֲטִין (H5845) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: עֲטִין (ʻăṭîyn) means a receptacle (for milk, i.e. pail; figuratively, breast) First listed occurrence: Job 21 24.

definitions.short: a receptacle (for milk, i.e. pail; figuratively, breast)
definitions.full: H5845. atin [ עֲטִין ] noun [masculine] probably pail, bucket (Late Hebrew מַעֲטָן vessel for olives ); — חָלָב מָֽלְאוּ עֲטִינָיו Job 21:24 his pails are full of milk.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning apparently to contain;
